title: Retrieval: dense vs BM25 vs hybrid with reranking
why: Hybrid search with reranking is the standard retrieval stack of production RAG (docs/SOURCES.md, lab sources).
notes: 2004 resolved power questions as documents, 186 October 2026 queries; relevance is graded from template, entity, date and threshold (see the module docstring), never by hand.
The live agent keeps its dense retriever; nothing here changes a live forecast.
limits: Relevance is graded from question metadata, so it rewards matching template, entity and a similar threshold; it says nothing about whether the retrieved questions improve a forecast.
One domain (electricity), one month of queries; queries on the same day are correlated and the differences between arms were not tested for significance.
Cross-encoder latency is measured on a shared 2-core CPU and varies between runs.
